text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 1245
TRANSFERRING AND CONVEYING CABAN AND SOMBRERO ISLANDS, BATANGAS PROVINCE,
TO THE PHILIPPINE TOURISM AUTHORITY FOR TOURISM DEVELOPMENT PURPOSES
By virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the
Philippines, hereby transfer and cede to the Philippine Tourism Authority for tourism development the Islands
of Caban and Sombrero located in Batangas of 55 hectares and 3 hectares, respectively.
All laws, proclamations, executive orders or decrees in consistent herewith are hereby revoked or amended
accordingly.
The Philippine Tourism Authority may not alienate the said islands or any portion thereof without the prior
approval of the President of the Philippines, although it may encumber the same to any government financing
institution for tourism development purposes.
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
